text:
Alex R: heads-up 12 small tenants are firing lots of p99 alerts from the SLO card. thinking we add a per-tenant sampling + soft quiet-window in the console so teams can tune without editing infra rules
Maya: good call. today sampling is global. UI should let a tenant set sample_rate, quiet_window, and show an estimated alerts/hr preview + cost delta
Kevin: i'd add a "notify_priority" slider too (high/normal/low) that maps to routing tiers. also a notify_budget percentage to cap notifications per period
Alex R: rough rule payload we could create from UI (pseudo):
```json
{
  "slo_id": "http.latency.p99",
  "window": "5m",
  "expr": "p99>750ms",
  "sample_rate": 0.15,
  "quiet_window_s": 1200,
  "notify_budget_pct": 60,
  "routing": ["pagerduty","email"],
  "meta_tags": ["tenant_id","preview_id"]
}
```
Jess: edge-case: short, high-severity bursts during deploys should be bypassable. propose `bypass_for_rollout=true` and tie to deployment metadata in alerts
ops-bot: policy-sim run (sample_rate=0.15, quiet_window=1200) -> est alerts/hr -44%, median time-to-alert +9s, false-positive rate -2.8%
Kevin: API notes: accept both explicit rule JSON and compact UI form. keep rule_id stable so we can patch sample_rate without replacing rule (avoid duplicate incidents)
Maya: UX: default to "balanced" preset (lenient/balanced/strict). expose advanced settings for explicit numbers. preview should show per-bucket impact (by exposure_bucket)
Jess: rollout plan: (1) UI toggle + dry-run API + preview snapshot (2) internal beta (3) canary to 5% tenants grouped by exposure_bucket (4) observe metrics: alerts_per_tenant_hr, ack_time, escalation_rate
Kevin: telemetry: emit alert_fingerprint, used_sample_rate, preview_snapshot_id in the fired event so we can do unbiased backfills
Alex R: actions:
- @Maya mock the console flow and preview UI (due Thu)
- @Kevin write API contract + compatibility shim (PR next Tue)
- @Jess define bypass_for_rollout semantics and tests (start Mon)
- @ops-bot run policy-sim across a random tenant sample once API spec exists
Maya: ack. i'll include an estimated cost delta and confidence bands in the preview
Jess: also persist last_preview_snapshot per-tenant so ops can repro pre-change state on escalation
Kevin: privacy/regulatory note: quiet_window might mask PII-exfil patterns. add a regulator-exempt flag on certain alert classes so quieting doesn't apply
Alex R: keep defaults conservative. advanced controls opt-in. will open RFC after mocks land. thanks :thumbsup:
